messages:
Lena (PM): FYI from customer call: the spend timeline + token breakdown layout is confusing when you toggle Org vs Project. They expected invoices and download CTAs to remain visible without extra scrolling. Screenshot: https://files.internal/redwood/spend-toggle-hidden-cta.png

Harper (Product Designer): Noted. My quick proposal: split the panel header into two zones — left: scope selector + primary invoice actions; right: chart title + controls. On narrow screens collapse chart controls into a kebab but keep invoice actions pinned left. Mock: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi789/billing-header-split

Diego (Frontend): Can implement pinned left zone but need to be careful about DOM order for screen readers. I'll keep invoice buttons first in DOM and visually float the chart controls right. Also adding a feature flag (billingHeaderSplit) so we can try with internal users.

Wei (Data): For token breakdown, customers with many token types see hundreds of rows. Suggest default: show top-4 by USD spend, then "See all" opens modal with full paginated list. Backend can return a paginated endpoint if we pass ?scope=project|org.

Sofia (QA): Accessibility checklist:
- ensure pinned CTAs are first focusable element
- any show/hide must update aria-expanded on triggers
- modal must trap focus and return focus to trigger on close
- add aria-live polite region to announce scope changes and "top-4 shown"
I'll add these to the QA template.

Harper (Product Designer): Also thinking about the token chips: add a small numeral (USD) and percent so users can read contribution at-a-glance. For color collisions, use a patterned subtle border for tokens with similar hues.

Diego (Frontend): Patterned borders fine, but lazy-render them for big lists. For the pinned CTAs I'll implement keyboard shortcuts: pressing "i" from the panel header focuses "View invoices" (need to confirm no conflicts). Will document in the keyboard shortcuts help.

Wei (Data): CSV export note: make sure we include scope column and preserve token ordering (top-4 then rest). Add header comment line like "# legend_order: top-by-usd" so downstream tools can interpret.

Lena (PM): Great. Action items: @Harper update figma with header-split + chip numerals, @Diego prototype with feature flag + keyboard shortcut, @Wei update export endpoint with scope and legend header, @Sofia add QA checks & run a11y smoke on the prototype. Sync Thursday 10:30am PT.

BillingBot: Invoice #INV-2026-900 generated for acct-4321: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-900.json

Diego (Frontend): I'll open a draft PR in the morning and include a Storybook story demonstrating pinned CTAs and top-4 collapse.
